risk_note: RV2 money (union taobao / pdd adapters, union registry and module wiring). D10-1250 ② (B1-18 leftover), BR-CALC-03 service fee fallback: only when an order's payload has no service fee amount (existing behaviour unchanged when it has one, B1-04zz / B1-08zh). Taobao: the dto fee amounts (falling back to alimama_share_fee as before) → the dto's alimm_tech_service_rate (same percent → bp conversion as the file's other rates; an invalid rate is warned and gives null, it does not fall through; '0' is a valid 0 bp; its unit is unverified and marked in a TODO) → config union.taobao.service_fee_bp. PDD: duo_id_service_fee → config union.pdd.service_fee_bp. JD unchanged (net payload). fee = ceil(gross × bp / 10000) via mulDivCeil on bigint (conservative N), N = gross − fee, service_fee_fen = the fee taken; est uses pub_share_pre_fee_for_commission, settle (tk_status 3) pub_share_fee_for_commission, PDD promotion_amount. Config shape decided here and pinned by the rule tests: object keyed by order type (Taobao: the payload's order_type, else '*'; PDD: '*' only), value {bp 0..10000 integer, source non-empty, verified boolean}; verified=false is used and warned; any invalid entry makes the whole value count as no configuration (warned); nothing configured → est / settle null → the existing SERVICE_FEE_RATE_MISSING pending path, never a fee of 0. The keys were registered (object, no seed rows, no rates filled) by prerequisite test-change B1-18et (#3178, merged). Production: createUnionRegistry hands each adapter only its own key; union.module reads it through the existing price-config port (app.module's createContentReader) by ctx.appId; union does not import content. One deviation from the brief, kept to satisfy frozen [AC-B1-04zz#23]: a missing alimama_share_fee key counts as invalid (already warned field_invalid) and does not fall through; only a JSON null / '--' value does. Negative gross (D10-572) uses mathematical ceil; an int64-min negation overflow gives null. A failing config read is not swallowed (listOrders fails and the sync retries). specs/attribution.md updated. Host: tsc -b apps/api 0; eslint / prettier / depcruise 0; test/spec/union 289 files 5110; apps/api unit 598 files 5117; int spec/union 693, spec/orders 1899; rule tests 60 green. Follow-up (orchestrator 11-11): the unit of alimm_tech_service_rate is not stated in the official field manual (rebate-private docs-mirror/taobao/aff-open-docs/server-api/tbk-server-api.json); the private recording rebate-private/cap-tests/2026-10-31/dataoke/orders-shapes.json (26 rows) shows a two-digit JSON integer next to percent-string alimama_rate, consistent with percent; read as percent and marked 未核实 in code and specs/attribution.md (to be logged as a CAP-TB-04 unknown); a warn taobao_order_service_fee_from_rate fires when that tier is used.

reviews.note: Codex money review (effort medium): round 1 pass, no findings, on the fallback implementation; round 2 (incremental, on 40b0b895921f) pass, no findings, after the orchestrator's 11-11 follow-up: the alimm_tech_service_rate unit is sourced (official field manual has no unit and sibling rates in the same response are percents; the 2026-10-31 Dataoke recording shows a two-digit JSON integer next to percent-string alimama_rate) and read as percent marked 未核实 (TODO blocked on CAP-TB-04); a warn taobao_order_service_fee_from_rate is emitted when the payload rate (no amount) is used, through the existing orderWarn sink, no metric, no order id / amount / user, at most once per row. Amount logic unchanged.
